_about: How the skill protects people. 'sweep' finds sensitive vocabulary in a story's text; a story that contains it must carry a sensitivity flag or a note saying why not. 'specific' words are never allowed in findings or other summaries (they would point to one person's story). 'allowed_generic' is the one general phrase findings may use for the class of detail.

sweep.menstrual: menstru|sanitary|first period|got (my|her) period|during (my|her|their) periods?|माहवारी|मासिक धर्म|पीरियड|सैनिटरी|माय पैड|my pad

specific: first period|sanitary|used cloth|menstrual cloth|blood on|father was killed|mother was killed|was killed|elephant attack|died|death of|passed away|widow|rape|abuse|suicide|miscarriage|\bHIV\b|leprosy|tuberculosis|cancer|broken arm|broke his arm|broke her arm|foot sores|sores on|disabled|मृत्यु|मौत|विधवा|कुष्ठ|माहवारी|पीरियड|सैनिटरी
allowed_generic: personal health, injury, bereavement or menstrual detail
